legal.privacy.title: Privacy policy
legal.privacy.content:
LEXOFT is committed to protecting the privacy of visitors to this site, in compliance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the French Data Protection Act.

Data controller

LEXOFT EURL (SIREN 984607226), Orléans (45), France — lexoft.eurl@gmail.com

Data collected

Via the contact form, we collect your name, email address and the content of your message. No data is collected without your action.

Purpose and legal basis

This data is used solely to respond to your enquiry. The legal basis is your consent, given when you submit the form.

Recipients and retention

Your data is processed only by LEXOFT and is never sold or transferred to third parties for commercial purposes. It is kept for a maximum of 24 months after the last contact, then deleted.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectify, erase, restrict and object to the processing of your data, as well as the right to data portability. To exercise these rights, contact us at lexoft.eurl@gmail.com. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

Cookies

This site does not use advertising or tracking cookies. Only the technical storage required for language preference is used.
